milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must be within 16 blocks of the green wool center and facing toward it. The green wool is at spawn-relative [0.5, 0.5, 3.5]. Since the wool is directly in the player's initial line of sight (only 3-4 blocks ahead), this should trigger almost immediately when the player looks forward. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the wool.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must be within 16 blocks of the nether brick stairs center and facing toward it. The stairs are at spawn-relative [3, 1, 7]. The player needs to move past the green wool and look toward the nether brick structure. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually observing the stairs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must be within 8 blocks of the brown banner and facing toward it. The banner is at spawn-relative [4, 3, 11] on an elevated platform. A tighter max_distance of 8 is used (instead of 16) because the banner is small and elevated — the player needs to get closer and look up to properly observe it. This also prevents premature triggering from spawn. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the banner.
